name: node-rm-warn-not-block-decision
body: Decision (with the user): `apg node rm` warns and proceeds when the node it removes is reviewed by outstanding Feedback. Removing the node is frequently the fix a Feedback item asks for (e.g. "this node is unnecessary"), so refusing the removal would defeat the item. The warning names the outstanding items; the record and its reviewed-target reference persist; the writer claims the fix; and the reviewer resolves or rejects it.
